tool_args.rationale: The observations combine strong sink-gradient dependence with a long-horizon sign reversal. Eight rows, only three at long horizons, leave the coupled temporal and sink effects ambiguous; finer trajectory observations can distinguish them before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-modulated dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The three long-horizon observations establish reversal but do not independently identify the sink dependence and slow adaptation dynamics of a coupled five-parameter law.
The existing slow-horizon probe already spans the reversal; a trajectory batch is more useful for resolving its dynamics.
It does not discriminate the candidate mechanisms.
